hooks.prompt: Before executing any command, check if the tool input contains a Bluetooth MAC address operation. If a MAC address is present but does not match the pattern ([0-9A-Fa-f]{2}[:\-]){5}[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}, deny the tool call and respond with: 'Invalid MAC address format. Use AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.' Otherwise approve.

This plugin only modifies files inside lib/features/bluetooth_scanner/ and lib/features/watch_scanner/. If the target file path is outside those directories, deny the write and explain the constraint. Otherwise approve.

PreInvocation.prompt: You are operating inside a Flutter project using MVVM architecture. Each screen has exactly two files: a VU (view) file and a VM (viewmodel) file. For Bluetooth scanning, the relevant files are bluetooth_scanner_view.dart (VU) and bluetooth_scanner_viewmodel.dart (VM). The scan is driven by flutter_blue_plus. Always route MAC address storage through setTargetMac() and scanning through startScan() on the ViewModel.
